prompt:
Illustration for a collectible Digimon trading card showing Agumon.
The attached image is a reference sheet of the 3D game model from three sides (3/4, front, side). They are low-polygon PlayStation models: keep each design EXACTLY (proportions, head shape, eyes, claws, colours and markings), but do NOT reproduce the polygon facets or the flat shading: render smooth, rounded, organic forms, soft skin with gentle subtle shading and fine detail, as a polished high-quality 3D illustration. Friendly and heroic; keep the chibi proportions of the models (big head, small body).
Pose: lively three-quarter view, full body visible from head to feet. Setting: a blazing volcanic landscape, embers and warm orange-red light, painterly and colourful, with depth behind the creature and a clear single subject.
Composition: the creature centred, filling about 70% of the height, with comfortable margins on every side (the card crops the edges). Soft, even light. No light beams, no god rays, no haze, no glare.
Strictly: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no card frame, no UI. Square image.
reference: 3D model reference sheet of each species (cardmaker.py ref)
